In Boca Raton, 13 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 13 dance and ballroom studios serving the Boca Raton market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 46 to 81. The AI engines name only five of the 13. The field averages 61 (D) on AI readiness, 13 of 13 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 10 of 13 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 29 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Boca Raton, FL area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 13 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray Dance Studio Parkland (81) and Boca Latin Dance Studio (78) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 46. Three scores are shared. Every one of the top five still carries at least one D or F category.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 61 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 13 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 10 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Seven of the 13 are franchise locations (five Fred Astaire and two Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #13 is 35 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Boca Raton.” Studios that serve Boca Raton from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (13 studios): arthurmurrayparkland.com, bocalatindance.com, fredastaire.com/delray-beach, fredastaire.com/boca-raton, fredastaire.com/boynton-beach, fredastaire.com/west-boca, aleclazoparamountdance.com, fredastaire.com/deerfield-beach, thedanceflow.com, americandancesportcenter.com, arthurmurrayboca.com, thedelrayballroom.com, ballroomdancelessonsnow.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 29 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Boca Raton dance searches. The South Florida coast is split into three pages: Miami (Miami-Dade), Fort Lauderdale (Broward) and Boca Raton (south Palm Beach County), with West Palm Beach covering the north of Palm Beach County. Dance Flow has three Google listings here (Boca Raton, Delray Beach and Deerfield Beach) on one website; they're counted as one studio, at the best position any of them reached. Google lists five Fred Astaire studios in this area, each with its own page, and each is rated separately. Left out: Dolce Vita Dance Studio (social media only, though Google's AI Mode names it), Sway Dance Studio in Delray Beach (its domain no longer resolves), Dance With Me at the Cabin by the Sea (its website returns an error), and the youth, ballet and recital studios that lead the broad answers (Boca Dance Studio, Creative Souls Dance, Boca Ballet Theatre).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 29 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Boca Raton, FL?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Boca Raton, FL?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 29 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons boca raton fl”; “dance lessons boca raton fl”; “salsa lessons boca raton fl”; “wedding dance lessons boca raton fl”; “ballroom dance lessons delray beach fl”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in boca raton fl” and “ballroom dance studio boca raton”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
